purpose: A separately declared CUDA comparison of the frozen 2-D cylinder control arms R1, R3_domain and M1_mutant (cyl2d_contract.json 9d53cd1 + ddc7095; band cyl2d_band.json 5a02b46) on one H100, one arm at a time. Equations, domain, boundary conditions, grid, t_end, force normalisation, averaging, reference bands and the mutant criterion are those of the CPU packet 95ac40c9 (repaired as 3507d462 on VM03) and of the R2 packet 751a23c3; only the backend differs, and the code changes are declared in backend_declaration.

backend_declaration.backend: CUDA (Float32, env_gpu pins: the 751a23c3 R2 packet's env) instead of the CPU packet's CPU (env Manifest). Every run JSON carries gpu: true and eval.json reports backend per run; nothing here is labelled CPU.
backend_declaration.solver_source: cyl2d.jl, cyl2d_contract.json, cyl2d_band.json and env_gpu are byte-identical to those in R2 packet 751a23c3 (cyl2d.jl differs from the CPU packet's ebc21ef0 by the host copy of p for surface sampling and Float32 series with series_dtype; on T_restart the two give equal series after Float32 rounding, r2-packet-controls.json)
code_changes: cyl2d_entry.py: calibration times every arm (arms form) and adds each arm's measured process start-up to its projection; cases_sequential runs one arm at a time and does not start an arm whose calibrated projection no longer fits
cyl2d_eval.py: reports backend per run, backends and mixed_backends in the verdict (reported, not a criterion; no criterion changed)
backend_declaration.not_relabelled: these runs are CUDA R1/R3_domain/M1_mutant. They do not replace VM03's CPU runs; both are kept and reported separately

science: model diagnostics; never 'passed'. eval.json here evaluates R1, R3_domain and M1_mutant on CUDA (periodicity, band, mutant); R2_fidelity, grid_pair and control_passes need the returned R2 as well, combined by cyl2d_eval.py afterwards with every original criterion. The 3-D C1 sphere reference gate FAILED and stays failed. No fin, fish, swimming or flight claim.

reference_gate.C1_sphere_3d: FAILED (|Cd| 0.875 at D16 CPU, 0.918/0.881 at D32 GPU, vs band [0.95, 1.35]); blocks physical-validation wording
reference_gate.cyl2d: frozen contract + band; evaluator fails closed (a92d80e)

platform_note: R1/R3_domain/M1_mutant here run on CUDA (Float32, env_gpu pins); VM03 runs the same arms on CPU. Same WaterLily 1.10.0 and Julia 1.12.7; the same-state control measures the CPU/CUDA difference on one shared flow state in this job before any arm starts.

env.note: the same pins and digest as the H100 fish packet 5af94b3f, which instantiated and passed its CUDA gate on 2026-10-31

outer_budget_note: default 5400 s (root's initial 90 min). The dispatcher sets CFD3D_OUTER_BUDGET_S = science budget; the calibration rule compares the arms' summed projection with what is left of it. Requested before dispatch: 7200 s (see handoff), because the conservative projection does not fit 5400 s

same_state.tolerance_units: Cd, Cd_p, Cl: max |difference| over the compared steps divided by the CPU mean |Cd|; t: max relative difference; u_abs: max |u_cpu - u_cuda| over the whole field after the continuation, U = 1
same_state.tolerance_basis: frozen before any CUDA run of this code; 0.005 is the GPU tolerance the earlier CUDA platform gate used (packet.json local_cpu_pins rel_tol_gpu) and passed with
same_state.mutant: the same comparison with the CUDA series shifted by 10 steps must NOT be within tolerance (shows the comparison can fail on a developed shedding flow)

export_note: off by default; the dispatcher sets CFD3D_EXPORT_BYTES_MAX for checkpoint transport. With export_every_s 10800 > the budget, a snapshot is exported only when an arm stops at the budget (R1/M1 ~0.2 GB, R3_domain ~0.8 GB), listed in OUT/checkpoints/manifest.json; CFD3D_RESUME_FROM continues it

calibration.steps_basis: steps = t_end 600 x n_D 32 / dt (grid units). Lower: the start-up dt measured on CPU (R1 0.285, M1 0.122, R3 0.277; cpu_packet.json measured_local). Upper: developed-wake dt = 0.6 x start-up for R1 and R3 (the CPU packet's assumption). M1 (Re 25, nu x4): WaterLily's dt = 1/(max flux + 5 nu); R1's start-up and 0.6x developed dt give max flux 1.91 and 4.25 (nu = 0.32); with M1's nu = 1.28 that is 0.120 (measured 0.122) and 0.094, so 205k steps. All are ASSUMPTIONS frozen before any arm runs; each arm's own steps and wall_s are the measurement
calibration.rule: GO only if: every arm's TIMING rc 0 on the device; the sum over R1, M1_mutant, R3_domain of (steps_projected[1] x measured s/step x run_overhead 1.3 + that arm's measured process start-up) <= time left before the outer budget minus emit and checkpoint margins; every arm's nvidia-smi device-memory peak <= 0.8 x card total; every host RSS peak <= 10 GB. Otherwise rc 11: stop with the controls, calibration.json and nvidia-smi kept; no arm started. fits_time_lower_only reports when only the lower projections would fit (a decision for root/infra, not taken here). After GO the arms run in packet order; an arm whose own projection exceeds the time left when it would start is not started and is recorded so
calibration.note: force-free TIMING; run_overhead 1.3 (forces every step, host copy of p every 10th step after t = 100) is an ASSUMPTION; each arm's own wall_s and steps are the measurement

expected.h100_basis: R2 on H100 (aijob-e00dydgq6ps3hkzjfv): 13.363 ms/step, 0.905 ns/cell-step at 14.76M cells; controls through calibration took 765 s including a 356 s fresh env build

R1.h100_wall: NOT ASSUMED; orientation: ~4-6 ms/step if the 3.69M grid runs at 1.0-1.3 ns/cell-step, so ~0.2-0.25 h at the upper steps x 1.3

R3_domain.h100_wall: NOT ASSUMED; orientation from R2's 13.4 ms/step: ~0.55 h at 115k x 1.3

expected.output_note: gzip sizes from a synthetic Float32 series of the same length (shortest decimals, 4 series); total ~6-7 MB plus controls, under max_out_bytes 12 MB

outputs: runs/R1.json.gz, runs/M1_mutant.json.gz, runs/R3_domain.json.gz (each only if that arm finishes)
checkpoints/<arm>-<n>.ckpt + checkpoints/manifest.json (only with CFD3D_EXPORT_BYTES_MAX and an arm stopped at the budget)

host_requirements.caps: every Julia process tree <= 11 GB host RSS (systemd scope MemoryMax + MemorySwapMax=0 where available, and the RSS watchdog); the steps run one at a time
host_requirements.gpu: one CUDA device (target: one H100 80 GB), driver supporting CUDA 12
